subject: Invoice emission path decision & AP integration for Greenline Logistics
messages:
From: Sofia Duarte <sofia@greenline.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@greenline.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Invoice delivery & VAT evidence for Redwood services

Hi Marcus,

We are getting our AP team ready to receive invoices from Redwood for the pilot account (GL-4932). A couple of quick questions so we can map this into our AR system: 

- Can you confirm the available delivery options (email PDF, SFTP push, or portal ingestion/webhook)?
- Do you provide structured invoice XML/UBL output? If yes, can we get a sample schema?
- For EU VAT evidence, will invoices include your VAT registration and the required reverse-charge wording?

Our preference is to centralize in the portal if possible, but IT needs to validate the webhook and SFTP options before we commit. Please include the billing contact and the person who will be the invoice \"emitter\" in Redwood’s system.

Thanks,
Sofia Duarte
Finance Manager
Greenline Logistics
[ap@greenline.com]

--
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Duarte <sofia@greenline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & VAT evidence for Redwood services

Hi Sofia — thanks for the note and the clear priorities. Short answers up front, then an action plan.

- Delivery options: portal ingestion (preferred), API/webhook push, SFTP drop, or email PDF copy.
- Structured output: yes — we can emit both an XML (invoice-ubl) and a human-readable PDF. Sample XML attached.
- VAT evidence: invoices include Redwood’s VAT reg. number and a configurable reverse-charge line for EU customers. We can also include your VAT ID in the invoice header.

Attach: invoice-xml-sample.xml (structure only)

Proposed next steps:
1) If you want portal-only: we’ll create a billing user and set up the push so your AP has read-only access to the invoice archive.
2) If you need AP integration: we can enable webhook delivery (POST JSON/UBL) or SFTP; IT will need the host details and a public key.
3) Send PO number mapping and preferred sender name (who should show as invoice originator).

Kimberly — looping you in for SFTP/webhook onboarding and to confirm whether we should enable dual delivery (portal + email copies) for the first 2 billing cycles.

Sofia — can you confirm which AP contact will validate the SFTP host key and whether your AR system consumes UBL or a custom XML?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Revenue
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: invoice-xml-sample.xml (xml)]

--
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Duarte <sofia@greenline.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & VAT evidence for Redwood services

Thanks Marcus — a couple of operational clarifications from ops/finance: 

- For SFTP we require the customer's public key + preferred directory naming (we can create a per-customer path: /greenline/invoices/YYYYMM).
- Webhook: we publish a signed POST with HMAC header; we’ll need the endpoint and the consumer secret you’ll store. We can generate a test payload and a replay token window for your IT to validate.
- Portal-only: we can add up to 3 billing users and enable automatic PDF copies to a configured email (AP notify).

I recommend a hybrid trial: portal as the canonical source + webhook to your AR for automated ingestion. That gives you auditability in the portal and automated matching in AR.

Connor — please prepare the portal-onboarding checklist and the SFTP host details, and include an example of the invoice filename pattern we’ll use for PO reconciliation.

Kimberly Park
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: portal-onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

--
From: Accounts Payable <ap@greenline.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Duarte <sofia@greenline.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 11:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & VAT evidence for Redwood services

Hi Marcus / Kimberly,

Thanks — Greenline prefers the hybrid approach you suggested (portal canonical + webhook). Our IT supports webhook with an HMAC header and can accept your test payloads. Two requests from AP: 

1) Please include the PO number and our invoice recipient code (GL-AP-07) in the invoice filename and the XML header. Example filename: GL-AP-07_20270901_INV-000342.xml
2) For VAT, include both Redwood’s VAT (RE-987654321) and a reverse-charge statement when our VAT ID is present. We will provide our VAT number and the AP contact who will validate the webhook.

AP contact for integration: Tomas Eriksen <tomas.eriksen@greenline.com> (cc’d on this thread)

We’ll aim to validate the webhook test by EOD Monday.

Best,
Accounts Payable
Greenline Logistics

Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & VAT evidence for Redwood services

Thanks Tomas / Sofia — great, appreciate the clear PO/filename requirement and the AP contact. Next steps and owners: 

- Redwood (Connor) will provision portal access and push a test invoice by tonight to the portal archive.
- Redwood (Connor) will POST a signed test webhook payload to Tomas' test endpoint (please share the endpoint and preferred secret rotation cadence).
- Redwood (Kimberly) will ensure the invoice XML includes: PO number, GL-AP-07 invoice recipient code, Redwood VAT RE-987654321, and optional reverse-charge wording when your VAT is supplied.
- Greenline (Tomas) will validate signature and schema; provide any filename/namespace feedback.

Can we target full production cutover for invoices (portal + webhook) for the 2027-09-15 billing run? If Greenline needs email PDF copies in parallel for the first two runs, we can enable that for the transition window.

Action items:
- Tomas: share webhook test URL + contact details (reply to this thread).
- Connor: send the portal test invoice + SFTP host details if needed.
- Kimberly: confirm if Redwood should automatically toggle reverse-charge wording when a VAT ID is present in the header.

Thanks — will follow up with a short mutual action checklist once Tomas confirms.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Revenue
Redwood Inference
